gloss: each section; each department; each part

definitions.gloss: each section; each department; all departments
definitions.explanation: Every department or division within an organization. Used in business and organizational contexts.
Every individual part or component of a machine, structure, or system.

examples.japanese: {各部|かくぶ}に{連絡|れんらく}する。
{各部|かくぶ}の{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: Representatives from each department attended the meeting.

examples.japanese: {各部|かくぶ}の{予算|よさん}を{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to review the budget of each department.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}の{各部|かくぶ}を{点検|てんけん}する。
examples.english: To inspect each part of the machine.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}の{各部|かくぶ}に{痛|いた}みがある。
examples.english: I have pain in various parts of my body.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{各部|かくぶ}の{名称|めいしょう}を{図|ず}で{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the names of each part of the building in the diagram.

notes:
Composed of {各|かく} (each, every) and {部|ぶ} (section, department, part). A formal compound used in organizational and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各部|かくぶ}の{代表|だいひょう}: representative of each department
- {各部|かくぶ}に{通達|つうたつ}する: to notify all departments
- {各部|かくぶ}の{名称|めいしょう}: name of each part
- {各部|かくぶ}を{点検|てんけん}する: to inspect each part

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各課|かくか}: each section/division — {課|か} is a smaller organizational unit than {部|ぶ}
- {各部門|かくぶもん}: each division — similar but more formal
- {各所|かくしょ}: each place / various places — for locations rather than departments

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business communications, technical manuals, and official documents.
